newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against both the dollar and the pound on Monday, reflecting international market trends, commercial forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 20.0080 against the dollar from 19.9665 last Friday, and at 33.2245 for one pound from 33.0060 on Friday.
Dealers said that although commercial banks had no shortage of hard currency positions, the rupee was fixed weaker against the dollar to reflect trends in overnight international markets.
"The market is very quiet as forex demand is subdued with the lower levels of importers' requirements at this time of year," one dealer said.
The dealer added that banks' long forex positions arose after the central bank sold dollars in the interbank forex market at regular intervals during the past weeks.
